results.title: [Offline fixture] Malaysia Sales and Service Tax overview
results.snippet: Malaysia's Sales and Service Tax (SST) was expanded on 1 July 2025. Sales tax rates of 5% and 10% apply to taxable goods, and service tax rates of 6% and 8% apply to taxable services.

results.title: [Offline fixture] Windows 10 end of support
results.snippet: Windows 10 reached end of support on October 14, 2025. After that date, Windows 10 devices no longer receive free security updates unless they are enrolled in Extended Security Updates.

results.title: [Offline fixture] DuitNow
results.snippet: DuitNow is Malaysia's national real-time payment service. DuitNow lets people and businesses send money instantly using a mobile number, MyKad number or business registration number instead of a bank account number.
